title: The ZML generator's primitive ABI — request and response

occurrence.description: The D1 node identifier this body is emitted for, e.g. decoder/attn[layer=0].

arguments.description: The occurrence's D1 arguments, verbatim: resolved, defaults applied. The contract owns their grammar; this schema does not restate it.

states.description: The D4 state rule of each state the occurrence holds, keyed by the contract's state name.

physical.description: The opaque physical parameters addressed to this occurrence (generators/CAPABILITIES.md): block sizes, layouts, kernel selection, with `backend` as one optional key. Neither typed nor validated here, by design.

mlir.description: One MLIR `func.func` in textual form, whose function type equals the requested signature. The host parses it, appends it to the module, and names it as the decomposition of the occurrence's stablehlo.composite.

refusals.description: Why this request cannot be emitted, in the refusal vocabulary the generators share: one `name=value` per argument, record field or state rule not implemented. A response carrying refusals carries no body.

notes.description: Conventions this body reads into a contract that leaves them open. Recorded, never authoritative: where a note and the contract disagree, the contract wins and the note is a finding.

signature.description: The function type the host will call, in order. The host dictates it; the primitive fills the body. A returned function whose type differs is refused before it enters the module.

operand.description: One argument or result of the emitted function, named by exactly one of `port`, `slot`, `state` or `positions`.

port.description: A contract input or output port. Its leading axis is the element count of this invocation; the axes after it are D2's per-element shape.

slot.description: A contract parameter slot. Its shape is D3's, after the location has been assembled; it carries no element axis.

state.description: One payload component of a state the occurrence holds, as `state.component` (e.g. `kv.k`). Its leading axis is the capacity the deployment fixed, not an element count.

positions.description: The position index of a stream, named by the stream. One element per element of that stream, in the same order as the ports it indexes.

shape.description: The full concrete shape, as the host will pass it. Never per-element and never symbolic: the host has already resolved elements per invocation and state capacity from the deployment's workload.

state.description: D4's rule for one state, copied so the primitive can refuse a law it does not implement without consulting the derived document.
